name: Yamada Days
source:
Tatsubane Akira, an office clerk in a data entry company, is trying to find a way through a constantly buzzing noise in her head. It's too loud, it's too bright, it's too hot. And it only gets worse.

[From [url=https://mattemade.itch.io/yamada-days]itch.io[/url]]
